metadata.description: pmUSD/crvUSD Convex Deposit (cvxpmcrvUSD) is a Convex Finance receipt token on Ethereum, minted 1:1 when the Curve pmUSD/crvUSD stableswap LP token (pmcrvUSD) is deposited into the Convex Booster. Holding it represents the staked LP position, which earns the pool's Curve trading fees plus boosted CRV and CVX emissions without the depositor locking CRV for veCRV. The underlying pool pairs Curve's crvUSD with pmUSD, a USD-pegged stablecoin issued by RAAC and over-collateralized by tokenized gold reserves. The deposit token is a plain non-upgradeable ERC-20 deployed by Convex's Token Factory, with mint and burn restricted to the Booster contract.
